known_gaps: File and command semantics depend on the tool payload exposed by Claude Code hooks.

providers.name: OpenAI Codex
providers.rollback: Setup preserves the original bytes once at ~/.codex/hooks.json.agent-strace.bak before overwriting an existing file. Restore them with cp ~/.codex/hooks.json.agent-strace.bak ~/.codex/hooks.json. If no file existed before setup, remove the generated config with rm ~/.codex/hooks.json.
providers.privacy: Events pass through AgentTrace's normal redaction path; hook visibility is limited to fields emitted by the provider.
known_gaps: The setup command replaces hooks.json rather than merging; repeated runs retain the first hooks.json.agent-strace.bak snapshot.
The current integration documentation does not claim a Codex session-end hook.
File, command, and error coverage depends on PreToolUse/PostToolUse payloads.
